checks: Observed normal driving stays legal; sustained speeding triggers pursuit after actual sighting time on the current road geometry.
A moving sighting assigns a stable lead officer and distinct road junctions to intercept and containment units.
Separated search units cover distinct nodes and take identical routes for different hidden player locations.
An unsuccessful search emits one escape and clears heat; visible reacquisition interrupts search.
Arrest requires three stopped seconds beside a slow officer and is interrupted by movement.
Night patrols physically deploy from the station and expose varied, rate-limited dispatch and engine metadata.
Police impacts keep reciprocal body velocity and spatial sirens without a second contact impulse.
Civilian traffic and patrols keep finite physical motion and render matrices through a full minute on curved roads.
Snapshot replicas and repeated reset/disposal preserve bounded police state.
limits: Current curved-city road geometry, planar vehicles, line of sight and recorded event descriptors in Node. No browser GPU image or audible radio/siren test.
Search knowledge comes from sightings and camera reports; the UI still knows the player position to draw nearby police.
